record.question: Which team won the 2018 Santosh Trophy of Football?
record.explanation: Answer D: Kerela. Kerala beat Bengal 4–2 on penalties after a 2–2 draw to win the 72 nd Santosh Trophy on 1 April 2018. AIFF’s original final report names Kerala. The printed option Kerela is a spelling error for that state and is retained as printed in the answer text. Historical/source note: Printed Kerela means Kerala; source spelling is preserved and the explanation supplies the correct spelling. Reference: https://www.the-aiff.com/article/kerala-defeat-bengal-on-penalties-to-win-hero-santosh-trophy. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
